task_definition.task_description: Please scan the devices in my living room, check all of them for any health issues, and then send me a high-priority app alert saying the health scan is done and that you’re archiving the living room light state before applying the requested brightness. After that, get the living room light’s mesh snapshot, archive that light state, check the light’s current status, and then set its brightness to 65%.

user_input.query: Please scan all the devices in my living_room and check them for all_issues health problems. Then send user_123 a high-priority app alert on the app channel with this exact message: “Device health scan completed. Archiving the living room light state and applying the requested brightness.” After that, get the mesh snapshot for the living room light with ID light_living, archive its current state using the title “Living room light state archive before adjustment,” check its current status, and then set its brightness to 65%.
